checkpoints.name: diag-pencil-baseline
checkpoints.description: A 3D node-and-edge knowledge graph rendered in Qualia, dark theme, viewed in a browser viewport. PENCIL profile reference frame: warm off-white paper background, crosshatch shading, black ink edge strokes, with nodes, edges and labels all present. This is the frame the other pencil arms are compared against.
